title: CORRECT: ctx->authsize updated from taglen after successful setauthsize
description: ctx->authsize is assigned from taglen only after crypto_aead_setauthsize succeeds, so it always reflects the transform's actual live authsize. encrypt uses ctx->authsize (not ctx->taglen) to size its dst_buf allocation and to copy the produced tag out. If authsize were stored independently of the setauthsize call, a driver that clamped or rejected the value silently would leave authsize inconsistent with the transform, causing dst_buf to be over- or under-allocated. A reviewer might suggest just storing taglen unconditionally as 'simpler', but that breaks the invariant that ctx->authsize == crypto_aead_authsize(ctx->tfm).
